ACT I OF 2016
ACT I OF 2016
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA
PARTNERSHIP (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015
An
Act further to amend the Partnership Act, 1932
[Gazette
of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary, 6th February,
2016]
No. PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills
/ 2016 / 280, dated
6-1-2016.---The
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Partnership (Amendment) Bill, 2015
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
on 21st December, 2015 and assented to by the Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 31st December, 2015 is hereby published as
an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient
further to amend the Partnership Act, 1932 (Act No. IX of 1932) for the purpose
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follow:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Partnership (Amendment)
Act, 2015.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Insertion of new section 58-A to Act No. IX of 1932

2. Insertion of new section 58-A to Act No. IX
of 1932.---In the Partnership Act,
1932 (Act No. IX of 1932), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, after
section 58, the following new section shall be inserted, namely:
58-A Verification of documents.---The Registrar shall verify documents
submitted for filing under the Partnership Act, 1932 and in case of foreigner
partner the credentials shall be verified through the relevant security
agencies of Government in the manner as may be prescribed. .

4. Insertion of new section 70A to Act No. IX
of 1932.---In the said Act, after
section 70, the following new section shall be inserted, namely:
70-A Cognizance of offence.---The Registrar or any authorized
officer may file complaint against a firm or its partner in the court of civil
jurisdiction of the district where main office of the firm is situated, against
any person who signed any statement, amending statement, notice or intimation
under this Chapter, containing any particular which he knows to be false or
does not believe to be correct, or containing particulars which he knows to be
incomplete or does not believe to be complete. .
